notes.title: V1.2 Release
notes.content:
V1.2 Changelog:
* Hands should no longer get stuck in walls
* Players can now return to hub from final levels
* New level select UI on final portal
* Climbable objects now have a larger grab area
* Fixed some trophies not unlocking
* Laser mirrors don't move as much when you first let go
* Normal level 15 now has it's missing cube
* Final doors are now correctly unlocked
* Final hub now correctly re-checks the final portal's lock state

notes.title: V1.1 Stability and Tacos
notes.content:
V1.1 Stability and Tacos Update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779550/799f7f826b6fd911fe3c9224de4c4d0b1611187c.jpg[/img]

A month after launch and we've noted some bugs and made some improvements! The full change log is as follows:

[list]
[*] Added tacos that can be eaten by players (request by Reddit user ChrizTaylor)
[*] Tweaked platforming difficulty by making the player have a higher air movement speed and applying a very small momentum boost when first jumping (feedback from X user @JayRyan909)
[*] No longer force the player to drop grabbable when they've collided with wall traps (this was just more annoying than difficult)
[*] Fixed entity interaction rooms to display correct responses
[*] Fixed mirrored cubes to have their physics enabled when on the opposite side
[*] Fixed final portal sometimes not unlocking correctly
[*] Fixed jumping tutorial from playing even if they player has already cleared that room (so they obviously don't need to know how to jump)
[*] Fixed subtitles not correctly splitting up
[/list]

Thanks for your support as we continue to work on improvements!
